title: Intent DNA Lock
intent: Bind every execution to an immutable approved intent fingerprint.
problem: Without canonical intent fingerprint compared before every transition, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the intent dna lock contract.
context: This pattern addresses approved intent governs a multi-step job; its concrete control is canonical intent fingerprint compared before every transition.
forces: Correctness requires that stored fingerprint never changes after approval
Operational pressure can cause: noncanonical JSON changes the digest
solution: Implement canonical intent fingerprint compared before every transition. Verify the anchored symbol `IntentLockDenied` with `test_human_can_lock_quality_passed_intent` before reuse.
invariants: stored fingerprint never changes after approval
failure_modes: an alternate command path omits the check
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `noncanonical JSON changes the digest` and fails closed if the intent dna lock evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For intent dna lock, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to canonical intent fingerprint compared before every transition.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: approved intent governs a multi-step job
Do not apply when: operators need an editable draft rather than a locked execution
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: approved intent governs a multi-step job
not_when: operators need an editable draft rather than a locked execution
